Dismiss bottom progress messages by swiping left or right. Dismissal applies to the current message, including streaming appends; new messages can still appear.

Seen progress messages no longer reappear when switching apps or recreating the overlay. Each message expires after eight seconds instead of remaining visible for the entire run or pause. Messages received while the control center or floating menu is open are not replayed later. Full logs remain available in the app.

Includes regression tests for seen-message suppression, streaming updates, expiration, both swipe directions and accessibility dismissal. Update the installed release in place with the APK below.
